entities.summary: Franz Kenneth Stahl is an American musician, best known as a guitarist of the Washington, D.C. hardcore punk band Scream, alongside his brother Pete. He was formerly a member of Wool from 1990 to 1996, a backing guitarist for J from 1997 to 2005, and a member of the Foo Fighters from 1997 to 1999.
